Enterprise Buyer Terms

These Enterprise Buyer Terms govern how an Enterprise Buyer shops for and orders Merchant Passes on the Mezzofy B2B Exchange Portal. Every Order must meet the Minimum Order Quantity, and every invoice must be paid in full before Passes are delivered. Buyers choose between a Pooled Model, where Mezzofy releases Passes from a shared pool as they are needed, and a Full Purchase Model, where the whole quantity is delivered at once.

Before you begin

This is a binding commercial agreement between your organisation and Mezzofy for use of the B2B Exchange Portal at exchange.mezzofy.com. It incorporates the Support Policy and any Order Form (clause 1.3), and the English version prevails. The Buyer accepts it by clicking “I Agree” at registration, signing an Order Form, or placing any Order.

§1

Parties and acceptance

1.1 This Agreement is between Mezzofy Holding Limited, a company incorporated in Hong Kong with company number 394841, and its affiliates that operate the Exchange Portal in the Buyer’s country (“Mezzofy”, “we”, “us”), and the organisation that registers for a Buyer Account (the “Buyer”, “you”).

1.2 The Buyer accepts this Agreement by clicking “I Agree” at registration, by signing an Order Form that references it, or by placing any Order. The person accepting confirms that they are authorised to bind the Buyer.

1.3 This Agreement incorporates the Mezzofy Privacy Policy, the Support Policy at mezzofy.com/support.html, any Order Form, and the Pass Terms of each Pass ordered. If documents conflict, the order of priority is: (a) a signed Order Form or master agreement; (b) this Agreement; (c) the Pass Terms; (d) the policies.

§2

Definitions

In this Agreement:

  • “Exchange Portal” means the Mezzofy B2B Exchange Portal at exchange.mezzofy.com, its APIs and related tools.
  • “Enterprise Buyer” or “Buyer” means a business, such as a bank, telco, employer, HR or benefits platform, loyalty operator or corporate gifting company, that buys Passes for distribution to its own users, customers or employees.
  • “End User” means an individual to whom the Buyer distributes a Pass.
  • “Merchant” means the business that issues a Pass on Mezzofy’s platform and provides the product or service it represents.
  • “Pass” means a digital coupon, voucher, gift card, e-ticket or other redeemable entitlement issued by a Merchant, identified by a unique Token.
  • “Pass Terms” means the conditions of a Pass set by its Merchant, including benefit, participating locations, validity, expiry and transferability.
  • “Listing” means a Pass offered on the Exchange Portal, with its unit price, Minimum Order Quantity and available quantity.
  • “Order” means a Buyer’s request to buy a quantity of Passes from one or more Listings, once confirmed by Mezzofy.
  • “Minimum Order Quantity” or “MOQ” means the minimum number of Passes, or minimum order value, that must be ordered for a Listing or an Order, as shown on the Exchange Portal or Order Form.
  • “Ordered Quantity” means the total number of Passes in a paid Order.
  • “Pooled Model” and “Full Purchase Model” have the meanings in clause 6.
  • “Balance Quantity” means, under the Pooled Model, the part of the Ordered Quantity not yet released to the Buyer.
  • “Turnaround Time” means the time Mezzofy needs to release Balance Quantity after a valid request, as set out in clause 6.5.
  • “Redemption” means the validation of a Pass’s Token by the Merchant, after which the Pass is marked used.
§3

Eligibility, verification and account

3.1 The Exchange Portal is for registered businesses only. Before placing its first Order, the Buyer must complete Mezzofy’s Know-Your-Business (KYB) checks, which may include company registration documents, tax registration numbers, beneficial ownership details and the identity of authorised signatories.

3.2 Mezzofy may decline or suspend a Buyer Account, or refuse an Order, where checks are incomplete, where the Buyer or its owners are subject to sanctions, or where Mezzofy considers there is a legal, fraud or reputational risk.

3.3 The Buyer may add authorised users to its account with different permissions, such as browsing, ordering, approving and downloading Passes. The Buyer is responsible for all activity under its account and must keep credentials secure, enable any multi-factor authentication offered, and notify security@mezzofy.com within 24 hours of any suspected unauthorised access.

3.4 The Buyer must keep its company, billing, tax and contact details accurate and up to date.

§4

Shopping and ordering

4.1 The Exchange Portal lets the Buyer browse Listings of Passes issued by Merchants, compare unit prices, Pass Terms, locations and availability, and place Orders. Mezzofy acts as the seller of the Passes to the Buyer on behalf of the Merchants and operates the exchange.

4.2 Pricing. The unit price of every Pass is fixed by its Merchant. Mezzofy does not set, discount or change Merchant prices. Listings and available quantities may change until an Order is confirmed, and the price in the Order Confirmation applies to that Order.

4.3 Minimum Order Quantity. Each Order must meet the MOQ for every Listing in it, and any minimum total Order value shown on the Exchange Portal or Order Form. Orders below the MOQ cannot be submitted. Mezzofy may agree a different MOQ in a signed Order Form.

4.4 When placing an Order, the Buyer must select its fulfilment model for each Listing: the Pooled Model or the Full Purchase Model (clause 6). The unit price is fixed by the Merchant and is the same under both models.

4.5 An Order is binding only when Mezzofy sends an Order Confirmation. Mezzofy may decline an Order, in whole or in part, where the Listing is no longer available, the Merchant has withdrawn it, or a pricing or system error has occurred.

4.6 The Buyer may cancel an Order free of charge at any time before it pays the invoice. Once the invoice is paid, the Order cannot be cancelled except as set out in clause 7.

§5

Invoicing, payment and taxes

5.1 Payment before delivery. Mezzofy issues an invoice for each confirmed Order. The Buyer must pay the invoice in full, in cleared funds, before any Passes are delivered. No Passes are delivered or reserved on credit unless a signed Order Form says otherwise.

5.2 The invoice is payable within 7 days of issue. If it is not paid in full by then, Mezzofy may cancel the Order and release the reserved quantities back to the Exchange Portal.

5.3 Payment may be made by bank transfer or through Mezzofy’s licensed payment providers, in the currency stated on the invoice. Bank, intermediary and currency conversion charges are borne by the Buyer, and the full invoiced amount must be received by Mezzofy.

5.4 Prices exclude GST, VAT, SST and similar taxes, which are added to the invoice where applicable. If the Buyer is required by law to withhold tax from a payment, it must increase the payment so that Mezzofy receives the full invoiced amount, unless Mezzofy agrees otherwise in writing.

5.5 For Buyers in Indonesia, invoices are issued and payable in Indonesian Rupiah where Indonesian law requires.

5.6 The Buyer must raise any dispute about an invoice in writing within 14 days of issue. Mezzofy will not deliver Passes for the disputed part of an Order until the dispute is resolved and the amount due is paid.

§6

Fulfilment models and delivery

6.1 For each Listing in an Order, the Buyer chooses one of two fulfilment models:

Pooled Model (redemption-based)Full Purchase Model
Quantity available after paymentAt least 25% of the Ordered Quantity, drawn from a shared pool100% of the Ordered Quantity
Balance QuantityTopped up by Mezzofy whenever the available quantity falls below 25%, subject to the Turnaround TimeNone — all Passes delivered at once
PricingFixed by the MerchantFixed by the Merchant
Best suited toProgrammes where only part of the issued Passes are expected to be redeemedFixed allocations, gifting and campaigns needing every Pass upfront

6.2 Pooled Model. Passes are held in a shared pool managed by Mezzofy, so that inventory can be used efficiently based on expected redemption. After the invoice is paid, Mezzofy makes available to the Buyer at least 25% of the Ordered Quantity (the “Minimum Available Quantity”), or the whole remaining Balance Quantity if that is less. The Buyer remains entitled to the full Ordered Quantity it has paid for.

6.3 Full Purchase Model. After the invoice is paid, Mezzofy delivers 100% of the Ordered Quantity, and Mezzofy holds no Balance Quantity for that Order.

6.4 Pool management and top-ups. Mezzofy monitors each Pooled Order. Whenever the Buyer’s available, undistributed Passes fall below the Minimum Available Quantity (the “Low Threshold”), Mezzofy will automatically top them up from the Balance Quantity back to at least the Minimum Available Quantity. The Buyer may also request additional Balance Quantity through the Exchange Portal or API at any time before the Order’s balance expiry date.

6.5 Turnaround Time. Mezzofy will complete each top-up within 7 business days of the Low Threshold being reached, and each additional Balance request within 7 business days of a valid request, or within the time stated in the Order Form or Support Policy. The Buyer acknowledges that Balance Quantity is not instantly available and must plan its requests to allow for the Turnaround Time. Turnaround Time is a target; a delay does not entitle the Buyer to a refund, but Mezzofy will keep the Buyer informed and fulfil the request as soon as possible.

6.6 Balance expiry. Balance Quantity must be requested before the earlier of the expiry of the Listing’s Pass validity and defined months from the Order date. Unrequested Balance Quantity at that date will be: (a) forfeited; (b) converted to credit for future Orders; or (c) delivered automatically — to be decided.

6.7 If a Merchant cannot supply enough Passes to fulfil a Balance request, Mezzofy will offer Passes of equivalent value from comparable Merchants, subject to the Buyer’s approval.

6.8 Delivery. Passes are delivered through the Exchange Portal as downloadable codes or links, by API into the Buyer’s own app or rewards platform, or by direct issue to End Users’ Marketplace accounts, as selected by the Buyer. Delivery is complete when the Passes are made available to the Buyer in the chosen channel.

6.9 Once delivered, the Buyer is responsible for keeping Passes and codes secure. Mezzofy is not responsible for Passes lost, leaked or misused after delivery, but will help void and reissue unredeemed Passes where it can verify they have not been used.

§7

Distribution, redemption and remedies

7.1 Distribution to End Users. The Buyer may distribute Passes to its End Users free of charge, as rewards, benefits or incentives, or at a price it sets, under its own branding. The Buyer must not resell Passes to other businesses, or list them on third-party marketplaces, without Mezzofy’s written approval.

7.2 The Buyer must present each Pass’s Pass Terms to End Users accurately and must not change the benefit, validity or conditions of a Pass. The Buyer is responsible for its own terms with End Users, including any promotions it runs with the Passes.

7.3 The Buyer must comply with all laws that apply to its distribution of Passes, including consumer protection, advertising, promotions, tax and data protection laws, and any rules that apply to it as a regulated financial institution or telco.

7.4 Redemption. End Users redeem Passes directly with the Merchant at the locations in the Pass Terms. Merchants are bound by their agreement with Mezzofy to honour every valid, unexpired, active Pass. Mezzofy’s validation record is the reference for whether a Pass is active, redeemed, expired or voided.

7.5 Merchant disputes. The Merchant is responsible for the product or service behind each Pass. End User complaints about quality or service should be directed to the Merchant; Mezzofy will help the Buyer escalate unresolved issues.

7.6 Merchant closure protection. If a Merchant permanently closes or stops operating so that delivered, unredeemed Passes can no longer be redeemed, Mezzofy will, at the Buyer’s request made within 90 days of notice of the closure, replace those Passes, and any affected Balance Quantity, with Passes of equivalent value from other Merchants on the Exchange Portal.

7.7 No refunds. Paid Orders are non-refundable and cannot be cancelled. Passes that expire unredeemed, whether with the Buyer or with End Users, are not refunded or replaced. The Buyer’s remedies are the delivery of the Ordered Quantity, the replacement of Passes under clauses 6.7, 6.9 and 7.6, and the correction of any error by Mezzofy.

7.8 Reporting. Mezzofy will provide the Buyer with dashboards and reports in the Exchange Portal showing, for each Order, the Ordered Quantity, delivered and Balance Quantities, and Redemptions.

§8

Data protection

8.1 Each party will comply with data protection laws that apply to it, which may include Hong Kong’s PDPO, Singapore’s PDPA, Malaysia’s PDPA, Indonesia’s Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 27 of 2022), China’s PIPL, the UAE PDPL, Saudi Arabia’s PDPL, India’s DPDP Act and the EU and UK GDPR.

8.2 The Buyer is the controller of its End Users’ personal data. Where Passes are delivered by API or code, Mezzofy receives only the data needed to issue, validate and report on Passes. Where the Buyer asks Mezzofy to issue Passes directly to End Users, the Buyer confirms it has a lawful basis to share their contact details with Mezzofy for that purpose.

8.3 Mezzofy will share with Merchants only the data needed to validate and fulfil a Pass, and will not use End User data received from the Buyer for its own marketing without the End User’s consent.

8.4 Where either party processes personal data on the other’s behalf, the parties will sign Mezzofy’s Data Processing Addendum. Each party must notify the other within 24 hours of becoming aware of a data breach affecting shared data.

8.5 Mezzofy may use Order and Redemption data in aggregated form that does not identify the Buyer or any individual, for analytics and to improve the exchange.

§9

Confidentiality

9.1 Each party must keep confidential the non-public information of the other, including pricing, Order volumes, Order Forms and End User data, and use it only to perform this Agreement.

9.2 This does not apply to information that is public through no fault of the recipient, already known to it, independently developed, or required to be disclosed by law or a regulator.

9.3 Confidentiality obligations continue for 3 years after termination, and indefinitely for personal data and trade secrets.

§10

Intellectual property and branding

10.1 Mezzofy owns the Exchange Portal, its APIs, Token technology and trademarks. The Buyer receives a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use them during the term to order, receive and distribute Passes.

10.2 The Buyer may display Merchant names, logos and Pass content only to promote and distribute the Passes it has bought, in the form supplied through the Exchange Portal.

10.3 Mezzofy may name the Buyer as a customer in its marketing only with the Buyer’s prior written consent.

§11

Warranties

11.1 Each party represents that it is duly organised, has authority to enter this Agreement, and is not subject to sanctions administered by the United Nations, the United States, the European Union, the United Kingdom or any country where it operates.

11.2 Mezzofy warrants that each Pass delivered is genuine, carries a valid Token, and is issued by a Merchant bound to honour it.

11.3 Except as stated in this Agreement and the Support Policy, the Exchange Portal is provided “as is”. Mezzofy does not warrant that the Exchange Portal will be uninterrupted, or that any level of End User take-up or Redemption will be achieved.

§12

Indemnity

12.1 The Buyer will indemnify Mezzofy and its affiliates against third-party claims, fines and costs arising from the Buyer’s breach of this Agreement or applicable law, its own terms or promotions with End Users, or its misuse of End User data.

12.2 Mezzofy will indemnify the Buyer against third-party claims that the Exchange Portal, used in accordance with this Agreement, infringes that third party’s intellectual property rights.

12.3 The indemnified party must give prompt notice, allow the indemnifying party to control the defence, and cooperate reasonably.

§13

Limitation of liability

13.1 Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for loss of profit, revenue, goodwill or data.

13.2 Each party’s total liability under this Agreement in any 12-month period is limited to the total amount paid by the Buyer for Orders in that period. This cap does not limit the Buyer’s obligation to pay invoices, or Mezzofy’s obligation to deliver paid Ordered Quantity.

13.3 Nothing in this Agreement limits liability for fraud, for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for breach of confidentiality or data protection obligations, or for any liability that cannot be limited by law.

§14

Term and termination

14.1 This Agreement starts when the Buyer accepts it and continues until terminated. Either party may terminate it on 30 days’ written notice.

14.2 Mezzofy may suspend the Buyer Account or terminate immediately if the Buyer materially breaches this Agreement, fails to pay an invoice when due, becomes insolvent, or if Mezzofy reasonably suspects fraud, sanctions exposure or illegal activity.

14.3 Termination does not affect paid Orders. Delivered Passes remain redeemable under their Pass Terms. Unless Mezzofy terminates for the Buyer’s breach, the Buyer may still request its remaining Balance Quantity under clause 6.6.

14.4 Unpaid Orders are cancelled on termination. Clauses on payment, data protection, confidentiality, indemnity, limitation of liability and governing law survive termination.

§15

Governing law and disputes

15.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

15.2 The parties will first try to resolve any dispute through good-faith negotiation between senior representatives for 30 days after written notice.

15.3 Any dispute not resolved by negotiation will be finally resolved by arbitration administered by the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre (HKIAC) under the HKIAC Administered Arbitration Rules in force at the time. The seat of arbitration is Hong Kong, the tribunal will consist of one arbitrator, and proceedings will be in English.

15.4 Either party may seek urgent interim relief from any competent court, or bring court proceedings to recover undisputed invoices.

§16

General

16.1 Changes. Mezzofy may update this Agreement by notice through the Exchange Portal or by email, with at least 30 days’ notice for material changes. Changes do not affect Orders already confirmed.

16.2 Assignment. The Buyer may not assign this Agreement without Mezzofy’s written consent. Mezzofy may assign it to an affiliate or a successor to its business.

16.3 Force majeure. Neither party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control. The Turnaround Time is extended by the length of any such delay.

16.4 Language. This Agreement is written in English. Translations (including Bahasa Malaysia, Bahasa Indonesia, Chinese and Arabic) are for convenience, and the English version prevails unless the law requires otherwise. For Buyers established in Indonesia, this Agreement is also provided in Bahasa Indonesia, as required by Indonesian law.

16.5 Entire agreement. This Agreement, with the documents in clause 1.3, is the entire agreement between the parties on its subject. The Buyer’s own purchase order terms do not apply, even if referenced on a purchase order.

16.6 Records. Mezzofy’s electronic records of Orders, deliveries, Balance requests and Redemptions are evidence of those events, absent manifest error.

§17

Contact

For questions or notices about this Agreement, contact Mezzofy at:

  • Orders and support — support@mezzofy.com
  • Legal notices — legal@mezzofy.com
  • Security incidents — security@mezzofy.com
  • Exchange Portal — exchange.mezzofy.com
